git add DESIGN.md internal/hook/pretooluse_dispatch.go internal/hook/session_end.go internal/hook/session_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
refactor(hook): dedupe the sidecar-clear list, name J1-J6 in DESIGN.md

Review findings J4, J5, J6 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004
round 3):

J5: internal/hook/session_end.go's clearSessionMissionBindings and
internal/session/store.go's clearMissionSidecars (K3) each
hand-maintained the same three-clear list independently -- a fourth
sidecar type added to one and not the other would drift silently, the
same shape J1 already found once this round between the CLI/MCP
queue-position copies. Deleted the hook-local duplicate: HandleSessionEnd
now relies solely on ss.Delete, which (per J3) already clears the same
three sidecars before removing the roster and propagates failure
instead of swallowing it. Fixing this exposed a real, previously
invisible test-fixture bug: internal/hook's shared testStores(t) helper
built its session.Store at an arbitrary temp dir, never at
$HOME/.punt-labs/ethos the way production's sessionStore() always does
-- invisible before this fix only because the OLD duplicate resolved
its own root via os.UserHomeDir() independently of the store.
TestHandleSessionEnd_ClearsMissionBindings now constructs its own
correctly-rooted store.

J6: matchDispatchPending's doc comment framed K1's "it can still
resolve on its own" as pure upside. Named the oscillation hazard
directly: dispatch m-A, git checkout away then back, and a stale entry
can resurrect to capture a spawn that has nothing to do with it --
DES-076's own misattribution class re-entering through the door K1
opened. The unbounded-warning-frequency half of J6 (one stderr line per
spawn attempt, forever, since each spawn is a fresh process) is
addressed by explicit decision, not code: a per-entry cooldown marker
was considered and rejected (its cleanup coordination with
ClearDispatchPending's dotfile-skip convention is worse than the noise
it removes) and recorded as a named, accepted residual in DESIGN.md
rather than either silently ignored or half-fixed.

J4: added a full amendment section to DESIGN.md covering J1-J6, the
honest residual-risk accounting the K round shipped without (the
abnormal-session-death gap was named in CHANGELOG but not DESIGN.md),
and a reflection on the fixture-shaped-test habit the reviewer asked to
have named so the next person avoids it.
EOF
)"
